description: No specific neurology referral or appointment scheduled upon discharge despite ongoing migraine issues and prior recommendation.
evidence_in_history: Plan in 2023-12-01 and 2024-06-10 visits includes scheduling neurology referral if headache frequency increases and suggested neurology referral if headaches worsen.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge plans include recommendation for neurology follow-up if headaches worsen, but no specific referral or appointment arranged.
suggested_correction: Document scheduling a specific neurology outpatient appointment or referral on discharge to ensure continuity of care for migraines.

description: No documented psychiatry referral or appointment arranged on discharge despite recommendation for psychiatric follow-up.
evidence_in_history: Bipolar disorder stable on current regimen with outpatient monitoring planned; recommendation for psychiatric follow-up noted.
evidence_in_summary: Psychiatric follow-up recommended but no referral documentation provided.
suggested_correction: Arrange and document a psychiatry outpatient referral or appointment on discharge to continue mental health management.

description: No outpatient laboratory orders for routine blood work (CBC and iron studies) placed at time of discharge despite recommendations.
evidence_in_history: Plan includes repeating CBC and iron studies in 3 months and further monitoring iron labs after 3 months if normalized.
evidence_in_summary: Routine blood work including CBC and iron studies recommended in 3 months but no lab order was placed on discharge.
suggested_correction: Place and document outpatient lab orders for CBC and iron studies at discharge to ensure appropriate monitoring of anemia.

description: Lithium serum level was drawn during hospitalization but results were pending at discharge and no clear plan to follow up on lithium level was documented.
evidence_in_history: Lithium level checked at 2024-06-10 visit and monitored as per plan.
evidence_in_summary: Lithium levels drawn but due to lab delays results were not available prior to discharge and no clear follow-up plan documented.
suggested_correction: Ensure documentation of plan for follow-up and management of pending lithium level results post-discharge with responsible provider and timeline.

description: No documented patient education on signs and symptoms of lithium toxicity despite clinical relevance and patient reporting mild hand tremors.
evidence_in_history: Office note dated 2024-06-10 notes mild hand tremor likely related to lithium and plan to educate about lithium toxicity signs.
evidence_in_summary: Patient education provided on medication adherence; however, no documentation of lithium toxicity signs education was found.
suggested_correction: Provide and document specific education to patient on signs, symptoms, and precautions regarding lithium toxicity before discharge.

description: No documentation of allergy reconciliation or review regarding penicillin allergy and potential cross-reactivity during hospital stay or at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Allergy record lists penicillin allergy with rash and mild urticaria; no mention of cross-reactivity or allergy review.
evidence_in_summary: No allergy reconciliation regarding penicillin cross-reactivity reviewed though patient has a penicillin allergy.
suggested_correction: Include allergy reconciliation addressing penicillin allergy, review for potential cross-reactivity, and document findings and counseling.

description: No initiation of migraine prophylactic therapy despite history of frequent migraines and discussion of prophylaxis if headaches increase.
evidence_in_history: Office visit #1 notes consider prophylaxis if headache frequency increases; headaches reported as 2-3 times per week then improving to 1/week later.
evidence_in_summary: No prophylactic migraine therapy was initiated during admission despite frequency of headaches.
suggested_correction: Consider and document evaluation for migraine prophylaxis therapy initiation if clinically indicated or rationale for withholding therapy.

description: No adjustment made to psychiatric medications despite patient reporting mild lithium-related hand tremor.
evidence_in_history: Patient reports mild hand tremor possibly lithium-related; Plan includes monitoring lithium side effects.
evidence_in_summary: No adjustments to psychiatric medications were made during admission despite hand tremors.
suggested_correction: Document consideration of medication dose adjustment or consultation for side effect management or plan to monitor and reassess.

description: Dietary review for iron deficiency anemia incomplete due to scheduling conflicts and no plan documented to complete this important aspect of anemia management.
evidence_in_history: Iron deficiency anemia with partial improvement; no documented detailed dietary review.
evidence_in_summary: Dietary review was incomplete due to scheduling conflicts; no plan to address noted.
suggested_correction: Schedule and complete dietary assessment and counseling for iron deficiency anemia and document in the medical record.

description: No consideration or documentation of intravenous iron therapy despite partial response to oral iron supplementation and persistent mild anemia.
evidence_in_history: Iron deficiency anemia with mild to moderate anemia; ongoing oral iron therapy with some improvement but not normalized previously.
evidence_in_summary: No intravenous iron therapy was considered during hospitalization.
suggested_correction: Evaluate and document consideration of IV iron therapy when oral supplementation response is partial or insufficient.
